text:
Morgan Geekie scored 39 goals last season, and the first month of this one asked whether that was real. Boston Hockey Now's answer this week: "Bruins' Morgan Geekie Finding Scoring Touch Again." He scored in four straight games before going quiet against Montreal, and now has 5 goals and 14 points in 19 games, half of those points on the power play.

The finishing is not the issue. He is shooting 17.2%, inside our range for him, and his own chances (1.12 expected goals per 60) are above last season's rate. The worry is the rest of his game. Boston is being outshot at five on five with him on the ice (45% of shot attempts), 3.5 points worse on expected goals than without him, and the Bruins have scored almost six goals more than their chances with him out there, which is padding his assists. His ice time has slipped by two minutes lately.

He still has one of the hardest shots in the league (99th percentile). Watch the new second line Yahoo Sports described, with Mikey Eyssimont; a line that keeps the puck is how he gets back to the version that scored 39.
